articles.title: Illicit Affair Turns Deadly: Daughter-in-Law Kills Mother-in-Law, Truth Exposed After Heated Famil
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking murder case has emerged from Hathras district in Uttar Pradesh, where a woman allegedly killed her mother-in-law with the help of her lover and tried to pass it off as a heart attack. According to police, Hina married Aamir in 2020 and lived with his family in Mathura.

body.html:
A shocking murder case has emerged from Hathras district in Uttar Pradesh, where a woman allegedly killed her mother-in-law with the help of her lover and tried to pass it off as a heart attack.

According to police, Hina married Aamir in 2020 and lived with his family in Mathura. Aamir and his father worked as drivers and often stayed away from home, leaving Hina and her mother-in-law Anwari Begum alone in the house.

During this period, Hina reportedly developed an illicit relationship with Aamir’s cousin, Adil. On the night of March 2, Adil allegedly came to meet Hina at the house. Anwari woke up and reportedly caught the two in a compromising situation.

Fearing that Anwari would reveal the affair to the family, Hina and Adil allegedly strangled her to death. Hina then informed her husband that his mother had suffered a heart attack.

Believing the claim, the family conducted Anwari’s funeral according to Muslim customs and buried the body.

However, days later, during a heated argument with her sister-in-law, Hina allegedly threatened her saying, “Just like your mother was killed, you will also be killed.” The shocking remark alerted the family, who then approached the police.

Following orders from district authorities, the body was exhumed on March 10 and sent for post-mortem. The report confirmed death by strangulation, not a heart attack.

Police subsequently arrested Hina, who allegedly confessed to the crime. Her lover Adil has also been arrested, and both are currently in police custody as the investigation continues.

articles.title: Shock in Maharashtra: Class 6 Girls Allegedly Made to Check Class 10 Board Papers in Satara School
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A surprising incident from Satara district has triggered outrage among parents after a teacher was allegedly caught allowing Class 6 students to check answer sheets of Class 10 board exam papers. The incident reportedly took place in Phaltan tehsil at Uttreshwar High School Vidani.

body.html:
A surprising incident from Satara district has triggered outrage among parents after a teacher was allegedly caught allowing Class 6 students to check answer sheets of Class 10 board exam papers.

The incident reportedly took place in Phaltan tehsil at Uttreshwar High School Vidani. Teacher Vaibhav Shende has been accused of getting Class 6 girls to check Marathi subject answer sheets of Class 10 students.

An alleged CCTV footage of the incident has surfaced, in which the teacher can reportedly be seen sitting with the students while they check the answer sheets together.

The incident has raised serious concerns about the integrity of the evaluation process and the future of students. Parents and locals have expressed anger, demanding strict action from the education department against the school administration and the teacher involved.

So far, the school administration has not issued any official statement regarding the allegations. However, the local education department has taken note of the matter and is expected to look into the incident.

Currently, the Maharashtra State Board of Secondary and Higher Secondary Education is conducting the board examinations across the state. The Class 12 (HSC) exams began on February 10, 2026, and will continue until March 18, while the Class 10 (SSC) exams started on February 20 and are also scheduled to conclude on March 18.

The controversy has intensified calls for stricter monitoring of the board paper evaluation process.

articles.title: Kidnapped in Broad Daylight! Businessman Screams ‘Bachao’ as Crowd Watches
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A businessman was allegedly kidnapped in broad daylight in the Pimpri-Chinchwad area near Pune, triggering concern after CCTV footage of the incident went viral on social media.

body.html:
A businessman was allegedly kidnapped in broad daylight in the Pimpri-Chinchwad area near Pune, triggering concern after CCTV footage of the incident went viral on social media.

According to police, the victim, Suresh Kumar, was abducted around 5.12 pm on Monday (March 9) near Fountain Hotel in Rahatani. The footage reportedly shows five men arriving in a black car and forcibly pushing the victim inside the vehicle while he screamed “bachao, bachao” for help. Bystanders at the scene were seen watching from a distance without intervening.

Police said the accused allegedly posed as officers from the Uttar Pradesh Police and forced the victim, who was travelling on his motorcycle in Shivraj Nagar, into the car.

Soon after the abduction, the kidnappers contacted the victim’s brother, a local businessman, and demanded a ransom of ₹50 lakh for Suresh Kumar’s release.

A case was registered at Kalewadi Police Station under Sections 140(1), 140(2) and 3(5) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023.

A joint team of the Pimpri-Chinchwad Crime Branch, the Anti-Extortion Cell and Kalewadi Police tracked the suspects as they attempted to flee towards Madhya Pradesh. After chasing the vehicle for nearly 100 km, police laid a trap near Hiwargaon Pawasa toll plaza in Sangamner in Ahilyanagar district and intercepted the car, rescuing the businessman safely.

Six accused — Chandrashekhar Deepchand Gaur, Dilip Mohanlal Saroj, Rinku Alguram Saroj, Anil Girdharilal Saroj, Mukesh Kumar Rammurat Chamar and Santan Suresh Chavan — were arrested in connection with the case.

Police also seized two pistols, six live cartridges, five mobile phones, a Swift car used in the kidnapping and a watch worth over ₹7 lakh. The total value of the seized property is estimated at around ₹18 lakh.

articles.title: Panic in Nalasopara Market: Uncontrolled buffalo bull Runs Through Crowd, Crashes Into Shop
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A frightening incident created panic in a busy market area of Nalasopara East when an uncontrolled buffalo bull ran through the crowded streets near Santosh Bhuvan Naka, injuring a two-wheeler rider and damaging property.

body.html:
A frightening incident created panic in a busy market area of Nalasopara East when an uncontrolled buffalo bull ran through the crowded streets near Santosh Bhuvan Naka, injuring a two-wheeler rider and damaging property.

According to reports, the animal suddenly ran onto the road in the busy market area and collided with a passing motorcycle, leaving the rider injured and damaging the vehicle. With no one controlling the buffalo bull, it continued running wildly through the street, causing chaos among shoppers and vendors.

Witnesses said the buffalo bull first hit the two-wheeler and then charged toward roadside vendors and pedestrians. People immediately ran in different directions to save themselves as the animal moved through the crowded market.

Several women and young girls rushed into a nearby plastic goods shop to escape. CCTV footage shows that the buffalo bull followed them and rammed into the shop with great force. However, the women quickly moved towards the back of the shop moments before the animal crashed into the exact spot where they had been standing, narrowly avoiding serious injuries.

The impact was so strong that the shop shook and several items, including goods, furniture and glass, were damaged. The terrifying moments were captured on CCTV cameras, and the video is now circulating widely on social media.

The sudden incident created an atmosphere of fear in the market area, which usually remains crowded due to the presence of many shops and heavy traffic. Fortunately, no major loss of life was reported, though one motorcyclist was injured and property damage occurred.

Authorities are expected to examine the circumstances surrounding the incident as residents raised concerns about stray or uncontrolled animals entering crowded urban markets.

articles.title: UP Cop Accused of Slapping Coconut Vendor, Loading Coconuts Into Police Vehicle
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A Sub-Inspector in Hasanpur has been transferred to police lines after a viral video allegedly showed him assaulting a street vendor and taking away his coconuts following a dispute over payment.

body.html:
A Sub-Inspector in Hasanpur has been transferred to police lines after a viral video allegedly showed him assaulting a street vendor and taking away his coconuts following a dispute over payment.

The incident occurred near the bus stand in Amroha, where Sagar, a resident of Mohalla Kala Shaheed, runs a coconut water stall. According to the vendor, Sub-Inspector Isham Singh, who was in charge of the Critical Corridor Team at Hasanpur bus stand intersection, arrived there with a colleague and consumed two coconuts.

When Sagar demanded ₹140 for the coconuts, the officer allegedly became angry. The vendor claimed the officer slapped him, threatened to remove his stall and forcibly loaded the coconuts from his cart into a police vehicle before taking them to the police station.

People present at the spot recorded the incident, and the video soon went viral on social media, triggering outrage among local traders.

Following the controversy, members of the Vyapari Suraksha Forum criticised the incident. Its state general secretary Mukesh Gupta termed the act “police robbery” and warned of protests if action was not taken.

After pressure from traders, the police reportedly returned the coconuts to the vendor. However, Sagar alleged that three coconuts were missing from the returned stock.

Sub-Inspector Isham Singh, however, denied the allegations and said the action was part of an anti-encroachment drive conducted to ensure smooth traffic in the town. According to him, on March 11 a campaign was carried out against roadside encroachments and 48 people were challaned under Section 34 of the Police Act.

He claimed that during the removal of the cart, the vendor angrily threw coconuts onto the road, which disrupted traffic. The coconuts were then picked up and placed back on the cart. However, the viral video shows coconuts being loaded into a police vehicle, raising questions over the explanation.

Taking the matter seriously, Superintendent of Police Amit Kumar Anand transferred the Sub-Inspector to police lines with immediate effect and ordered an inquiry.

The Hasanpur Circle Officer has been assigned to conduct a detailed investigation. Police said departmental action will be taken if the officer is found guilty.

articles.title: Gunman Fires at Farooq Abdullah at Jammu Wedding; NSG Team Foils Assassination Attempt
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dramatic assassination attempt on Farooq Abdullah was foiled in Jammu on Wednesday evening when an attacker allegedly fired a shot at him during a marriage ceremony.

body.html:
A dramatic assassination attempt on Farooq Abdullah was foiled in Jammu on Wednesday evening when an attacker allegedly fired a shot at him during a marriage ceremony.

The incident took place at Royal Park, where the Jammu and Kashmir National Conference president had gone to attend a wedding.

According to officials, the attacker managed to get within point-blank range of the 88-year-old leader, who is under Z+ security protection. The accused allegedly attempted to shoot him, but commandos from the National Security Guard quickly pushed the attacker, causing the bullet to miss the target.

Videos circulating from the scene show the suspect being caught immediately after the firing and thrashed by people present at the venue before being taken into police custody.

Police identified the accused as Kamal Singh Jamwal, a 65-year-old resident of Puranas Mandi in Jammu. After his arrest, he was seen telling police that he had been waiting for this moment for nearly 20 years.

In a statement, police confirmed that an attempt was made on Abdullah’s life during the wedding function.

Reacting to the incident, Omar Abdullah described it as an assassination attempt on his father and said he had a “very close shave”.

“Allah is kind. My father had a very close shave. A man with a loaded pistol managed to reach point-blank range and fire a shot. It was only the close protection team that deflected the shot and ensured the attempt failed,” Omar Abdullah wrote on social media.

He also raised concerns about how the attacker managed to get so close to a former chief minister protected by Z+ category security.

Farooq Abdullah was accompanied at the event by Surinder Choudhary and Nasir Sogami, advisor to the Chief Minister.

Sogami said it was clearly an attempt to kill Abdullah but added that fortunately no one was injured in the firing. Authorities are now investigating the motive behind the attack and whether there was any security lapse.

articles.title: Priest Murdered by Wife, Lover and Two Others; Body Thrown Into Canal to Stage Accident
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Police in Mandya district have cracked the suspicious death case of a temple priest, arresting his wife, her alleged lover and two accomplices for allegedly murdering him and dumping the body in a canal to make it appear like an accident.

body.html:
Police in Mandya district have cracked the suspicious death case of a temple priest, arresting his wife, her alleged lover and two accomplices for allegedly murdering him and dumping the body in a canal to make it appear like an accident.

The deceased has been identified as Siddalingappa, a priest at a local temple near Maralagala village. Police arrested his wife Shalini, her alleged lover Harish, and two others — M.R. Santosh Kumar and B. Ganesh — in connection with the murder.

According to preliminary investigation, Shalini and Harish, who is a resident of the same village, had been in an illicit relationship for several months. About one-and-a-half years ago, Siddalingappa reportedly caught the two together and repeatedly warned his wife to end the relationship.

Police said Shalini later conspired with Harish to eliminate her husband as he had become an obstacle to their relationship.

On March 6, Siddalingappa had gone to perform prayers at the Ganapati Temple. Investigators said that Shalini allegedly informed Harish about Siddalingappa’s movements through a message.

As Siddalingappa was returning home on his motorcycle via the canal road, Harish and his two friends allegedly intercepted him. During the attack, the accused reportedly struck him on the head with a club, killing him on the spot.

After the murder, the accused threw Siddalingappa’s body into the Chikka Devaraya Sagar Canal and pushed his motorcycle into the water to stage the incident as an accidental fall.

When Siddalingappa did not return home, his family began searching for him. During the search, his slippers and clothes were found on the canal bank, raising suspicion.

Police later recovered both the body and the motorcycle from the canal. Blood stains were also found near the spot where the slippers were discovered, further strengthening suspicion.

During questioning, police detained Shalini and Harish. After intense interrogation, the alleged murder conspiracy came to light, following which all four accused were arrested. Police said further investigation into the case is underway.

articles.title: Journalist Killed in Head-On Bike Crash — Shocking CCTV From Shivamogga
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A disturbing road accident from Vinoba Nagar in Shivamogga, Karnataka, has gone viral on social media after CCTV footage captured a head-on collision between two motorcycles on a narrow road.

body.html:
A disturbing road accident from Vinoba Nagar in Shivamogga, Karnataka, has gone viral on social media after CCTV footage captured a head-on collision between two motorcycles on a narrow road.

According to reports, the impact of the crash was extremely severe, throwing one of the riders onto the road and causing a fatal head injury.

The deceased has been identified as Anil Kumar Naik (44), a journalist who had worked with several news channels and a newspaper in Shivamogga. He was rushed to a private hospital after the accident, but doctors were unable to save him.

Naik is survived by his wife and three children. Members of the Shivamogga district unit of the Karnataka Union of Working Journalists and the Shivamogga Press Trust expressed deep sorrow and paid tribute to the late journalist.

The video of the accident has widely circulated online, sparking debate about possible causes. Some viewers claimed that a two-wheeler parked in the middle of the road may have contributed to the crash, while others pointed to high-beam headlights affecting visibility. Concerns about speeding, distracted riding, and lack of helmets were also raised, though the exact cause has not been officially confirmed.

Authorities are expected to examine the CCTV footage and other evidence to determine the circumstances that led to the collision.
